canonical_verification.rule: every canonical document is re-hashed and the digest is pinned. A side whose acquisition never recorded a canonical digest is pinned but NOT verified against acquisition, and is counted here rather than reported as if it were verified.

collision_policy.detection: structural, by cache key, before any digest is recomputed

confirmed_14.read_for: disjointness proof only; never a numerator or a denominator

v1_universe.read_for: lineage ids only. No V1 verdict, count or violated case is read, and V1's FAIL is neither re-opened nor re-interpreted.

selection_rule: the complete candidate universe as the enumerating lane leaves it, taken in the order the manifest declares, deduplicated by lineage id keeping the first occurrence, then filtered by the declared exclusion policy alone. No pair is selected or dropped by any property of its content, and no pair is selected or dropped by any closure outcome — V1's, V2's or any other. The selection function never calls either change predicate.
